items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: But I’ve known Ruby a great many years now.

ctx.x: Is there someone you hear frequently that in their own estimation of their playing is very unpretentious that you feel constantly rises to the occasion?

Well I think Ruby [Braff] is a good example of that, isn’t he? I think essentially that is what I’ve found so inspiring about him. But I’ve known Ruby a great many years now. And he never fails to find something special to say, yet I don’t think he’s trying to stand

up and say hang on, I’m of considerable artistic significance therefore please, you know, treat me in that sort of way. I’ll give you an example. I wrote a piece about him when he was appearing at Pizza Express in London, which is still a famous jazz club. And it’s a club where people come in to eat, and they make a lot of noise.
